name: Acceptance suite-2 test 50 - object action on a bucket-only ARN (action/resource-type mismatch)
note: IAM-1006 (F3): s3:GetObject is an OBJECT-level action but the Resource is a bucket-only ARN (arn:aws:s3:::documents, no key path). The bucket ARN identifies the bucket, not its objects, so this grant matches no object-read request. The engine must NOT report a confirmed object-read finding (no DATA-EXFIL / DATA-READ) AND must NOT report a complete, empty analysis: it surfaces a non-blocking coverage WARNING (code ACTION_RESOURCE_TYPE_MISMATCH, coverage incomplete) carrying bucket-vs-object remediation. Fail closed on the honest signal instead of a silent complete/empty result.
